audit_scope: Comprehensive Provenance & Leakage Audit for all ORCA ML & Analytics Components

weather.official_designation: ORCA Multi-Horizon Weather Model v4.0 trained on verified ECMWF reanalysis and operational analysis data, with source-specific provenance.
weather.data_source: ECMWF ERA5 / ERA5T / IFS via Open-Meteo Historical Archive API
weather.sampling_cadence: 6-hourly synchronous fixes (00, 06, 12, 18 UTC) resampled from continuous 1-hourly raw reanalysis
weather.horizon_buffer: 72 hours between splits (mathematically guarantees zero target crossing)

disaster.official_designation: ORCA 24h Cyclone & Marine Hazard Prediction Model v4.0 trained on verified NOAA IBTrACS and ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis data.

data_sources.name: NOAA/NCEI IBTrACS North Indian Ocean Archive (v04r01)
data_sources.missing_data_2026: Zero 2026 storms in official IBTrACS archive

data_sources.name: ECMWF ERA5 Marine Ambient Observations
data_sources.purpose: Clean, verified non-storm background reference fixes across 6 Indian maritime nodes

disaster.leakage_safeguards: Strict storm-disjoint SID partitioning, independent future target at t+24h, zero target in features

ocean.data_source: ISRO MOSDAC Shadow Cache (SARAL-AltiKa radar altimetry, Oceansat-3 scatterometer)
ocean.method: xarray coordinate nearest-neighbor slicing + moving window swell anomaly detection
